global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, amber broth glistening under warm light. Topped with menma, chopped green onions, and minced pork, it sits in a ceramic bowl with Japanese script, resting on a rustic wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows rich brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches with warm lighting reflections.
regions.bowl: Ramen bowl: ceramic, cream-colored with dark brown rim and black Japanese calligraphy script.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, rich amber color, glossy surface, visible strands and bubbles.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale brown, glossy, elongated strips with slightly curled, fibrous texture and visible surface ridges.
